node.description: Id of exactly one development {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

owner.description: The owner (user or user group) of the artifacts; default: inventory.owner of the {node}

diagramGroup.description: Import the changed and new workflows of this diagram group with their changed or new modules

modules.description: Instead of diagramGroup: import these changed single modules

pluginType.description: e.g. XSLT Converter; looked up in the workspace if missing

reason.description: Why; becomes the check-in comment of the new versions and is audited (no # or @)

confirmationCode.description: The code from the preview of the first call; executes the import
